Based on my search, here is information about **altavista.com**:

AltaVista was one of the **first major search engines** on the internet, launched in **1995** by Digital Equipment Corporation (DEC). It was groundbreaking for its time, offering several innovative features:

## Key Features & History
- **Fast search capabilities** - One of the first to index a large portion of the web
- **Natural language queries** - Allowed users to search using full sentences
- **Advanced search operators** - Boolean operators, phrase searching, and more
- **Multilingual search** - Supported searches in multiple languages
- **Babel Fish translation** - Popular machine translation service

## Decline and Closure
- AltaVista struggled to compete with **Google**, which launched in 1998 and quickly dominated the search market
- The site went through several ownership changes:
  - Sold to **Compaq** when it acquired DEC (1998)
  - Then to **CMGI**
  - Eventually became part of **Overture Services** (2003)
  - **Yahoo! acquired Overture** and thus AltaVista (2003)

- Yahoo! **shut down AltaVista** on **July 8, 2013**
- The domain **altavista.com** now redirects to **Yahoo Search**

AltaVista is remembered as a pioneer that helped shape how people search the internet, though it ultimately couldn't survive the Google era.

---

Sources:
1. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AltaVista
2. https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2013/jun/30/altavista-search-engine-closes-yahoo
3. https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-23103405
4. https://www.cnet.com/news/altavista-dead-at-18/
